answer.summary: 8 graph-interactions Firefox e2e tests failed on a scheduled run of main. The first failure is a deterministic console error: a CSP report-only violation from schemas-BmYp45oA.js (eval blocked, 'unsafe-eval' missing) that the spec's problems assertion treats as a failure. The change touches only Java OpenCRQ/XtmOne files, so it doesn't explain the graph UI failures directly. The log doesn't show the other 7 failure details, so the shared cause is inferred. A rerun would likely repeat the same console error, so retry is unlikely to help.
